set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: install libpam-pwquality =="
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
sudo -n apt-get update -qq
sudo -n apt-get install -y -qq libpam-pwquality

echo "== STEP 2: configure pwquality.conf =="
sudo -n cp /etc/security/pwquality.conf /etc/security/pwquality.conf.bak 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n tee /etc/security/pwquality.conf > /dev/null <<'EOF'
# Managed: require 12+ char passwords with at least 3 character classes
minlen = 12
minclass = 3
EOF

echo "== STEP 3: wire pam_pwquality into common-password =[REDACTED]

fi

  echo "WEAK_PASSWORD_REJECTED (expected)"

fi

  echo "STRONG_PASSWORD_ACCEPTED (expected)"

  echo "STRONG_PASSWORD_REJECTED (unexpected)"
fi

sudo -n userdel -r pwtestuser 2>&1 || true
